[中文](#cn-v0.5.1) | [English](#en-v0.5.1)

**画板坐标系的两处修复 + 列表尺寸口径。** 起因是把一个账号下的**全部素材**扫了一遍：
**6 团队 / 31 项目 / 1437 张设计稿 / 12 份原型**。

<h3 id="cn-v0.5.1">新增功能</h3>

本版不新增功能，是修复 + 口径澄清。

<h3 id="cn-v0.5.1">体验优化</h3>

- **`list_designs` 的尺寸标注为「预览」**：列表接口返回的是**缩略图尺寸**（实测 `187.5` ↔ 真实 `750`、`480` ↔ `1920`，常见 **¼**）。
  插件内部算 rpx 一直用**真实画板宽**（没错），但 AI 若拿列表尺寸自己换算**会算错比例** ——
  而这是实测语料里 **77%** 的稿都长的样子。现在**三处同时标注**：列表行标 `（预览）`、工具描述写明、
  `SYSTEM_HINT` 加警告（别拿列表尺寸算 rpx，用读稿标题行的画板宽）。

<h3 id="cn-v0.5.1">问题修复</h3>

**同一病根的第三、第四次复发 —— 都出在「坐标系混用」：**

- ⭐ **画板内边距跨坐标系**（影响**所有画板不在原点**的稿）：画板自身的 `x/y` 是**画布绝对**坐标（实测 `x=14599`），
  而它的子层是**画板相对**坐标（`x=0`）—— 代码却直接相减，于是深度 1 的层内边距全成了 `-14599` 这种数。
  修后与独立手算**逐位一致**（`0/287/1705/163`）。
- ⭐ **间距一览没排除画板**（`depth 0`）：画板自己作为「块」进了候选集 → 出现 `5987px`，而该稿画板对角只有 `551px`。
  上一版只挡住了 summary 那条链，**`renderGapDigest` 这条链漏了** → 在**唯一收口**处过滤。**10 条 → 7 条。**

> 加上 0.5.0 修掉的「画板被当元素」，这是同一病根的**三次**复发。代码里留了一句给后来者：
> **「新加几何计算时先问一句：这堆元素的坐标系一致吗？」**

<h3 id="cn-v0.5.1">其他变更</h3>

- 自检 **651 → 663 项**；变异测试咬住（去掉画板过滤 → 复现 `块A ↕ 画板 – 1 = 6055px` → 红 1 条）。
- **全量真机覆盖**：31/31 项目的 `list_designs` 与 `product-docs` 零报错；`read_blocks` 扫到 **997/1437**；
  9 张异常**全部定性**（7 张是插件**明确报错**「版本没有 json_url」= 源数据缺失，非 bug；1 张是上述间距 bug；1 张是检查器误判）。
- **三项此前未闭环的验证全部补齐（真机证据）**：① `region` 双单位在 w=1920/750/375 三种稿上给出 **×0.39 / 1:1 / ×2** ——
  换算比确实**按画板宽**、不是写死；② **找到了**原生「无填充无圆角切图块」（一张稿 4 个），并**带反证**（去掉放行 → 4 → 0）；
  ③ 齐平段**独立复算对账：漏报 0 / 多报 0**（3 张稿）。
- ⭐ **修复后做了全量回归**：拿修好的代码把同一批稿重跑一遍（**1219 张对账**）——
  某稿那条 `gap>diag(5987>551)` **消失**，**0 新增异常**（其余 92 张仍是"源数据缺失"的明确报错）。
- **如实记录未闭环**：`read_blocks` 总量 1437 仍在收尾；齐平对账样本 3 张偏小。

**Full Changelog**: [v0.5.0...v0.5.1](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-lanhu/compare/v0.5.0...v0.5.1)

---

<h3 id="en-v0.5.1">New Features</h3>

No new features — this release is fixes plus a clarification of output semantics.

<h3 id="en-v0.5.1">Improvements</h3>

- **`list_designs` labels its sizes as "preview"**: the list endpoint returns **thumbnail** dimensions (measured `187.5` vs a
  real `750`, `480` vs `1920` — commonly **¼**). The plugin has always computed rpx from the **real artboard width**
  (correct), but an AI deriving the ratio from the list would **get it wrong** — and that is what **77%** of the artboards
  in the corpus look like. Now flagged in **three places**: the list row says `（预览）`, the tool description says it, and
  `SYSTEM_HINT` warns not to use list sizes for rpx.

<h3 id="en-v0.5.1">Bug Fixes</h3>

**The third and fourth recurrence of one root cause — mixed coordinate systems:**

- ⭐ **Artboard padding spanned two coordinate systems** (affects **every** artboard not at the origin): an artboard's own
  `x/y` are **canvas-absolute** (measured `x=14599`) while its children are **artboard-relative** (`x=0`) — yet the code
  subtracted them directly, so every depth-1 layer's padding came out as `-14599`. After the fix it matches an independent
  hand calculation **digit for digit** (`0/287/1705/163`).
- ⭐ **The spacing section did not exclude the artboard** (`depth 0`): the artboard entered the candidate set as a "block",
  producing `5987px` where the artboard's diagonal is only `551px`. The previous version guarded the summary chain but
  **missed `renderGapDigest`** → filtered at its single choke point. **10 rows → 7.**

> With the "artboard treated as an element" fix in 0.5.0, this is the **third** recurrence of one root cause. A note was left
> in the code for whoever comes next: **"when adding geometry, first ask whether these elements share a coordinate system."**

<h3 id="en-v0.5.1">Chores</h3>

- Self-check **651 → 663 assertions**; the mutation is caught (removing the artboard filter reproduces
  `块A ↕ 画板 – 1 = 6055px` → 1 red).
- **Full real-machine coverage**: `list_designs` and `product-docs` across 31/31 projects with zero errors; `read_blocks`
  swept to **997/1437**; all 9 anomalies **classified** (7 are the plugin **reporting clearly** that a version has no
  `json_url` — missing source data, not a bug; 1 is the spacing bug above; 1 was an inspector false positive).
- **All three previously unclosed verifications are now closed (with real-machine evidence)**: ① `region` dual units emit
  **×0.39 / 1:1 / ×2** on 1920/750/375-wide artboards — the ratio really is derived from the artboard width; ② the native
  "image block with neither fill nor radius" was **found** (4 in one artboard) with a **counter-proof** (removing the
  allowance takes it from 4 to 0); ③ the flush section reconciles **0 missed / 0 extra** against an independent recount (3 artboards).
- ⭐ **A full regression followed the fix**: re-running the same artboards with the fixed code (**1219 reconciled**) makes
  the 某稿 `gap>diag(5987>551)` **disappear** with **0 new anomalies** (the other 92 remain the clear "missing source
  data" reports).
- **Honestly recorded as still open**: the overall `read_blocks` sweep of 1437 is still finishing; the flush reconciliation
  sample is only 3 artboards.

**Full Changelog**: [v0.5.0...v0.5.1](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-lanhu/compare/v0.5.0...v0.5.1)
